title: Monitoring SQL Database Deadlocks in Business Central

facts.text: Deadlocks occur when two or more transactions block each other from continuing over locked database resources
Deadlock information logged includes AL code executed, SQL deadlock report, and Business Central user account
SQL Server permissions required: View database state on database level and both View server state and Alter any event session on instance level
SQL Server 2022 and later also require VIEW SERVER PERFORMANCE STATE permission to read Extended Events diagnostic data
Enable deadlock logging on the Business Central Server instance using Set-NAVServerConfiguration with EnableDeadlockMonitoring parameter
Deadlock events are recorded in Windows event log with event ID 705 and task category 33
AL ObjectType, AL ObjectNumber, and AL ScopeName attributes in event logs may be empty if deadlock occurred on a different server instance
